node.statement: By the bijectivity assertion of lem-stage1-polar-retraction, the global set-theoretic inverse G=Pi_delta^{-1} exists. On every local target neighborhood obtained in the preceding step, G equals the unique smooth local inverse there. These neighborhoods cover S_delta as p ranges over the domain, so G is smooth because smoothness is local; this is exactly the local-gluing argument recorded in GT-lee-2ed-cor-C.36(b).
